summary: A compact, playable transition beat. Sayed’s practical warning carries authority and protective instinct, while Mostafa’s clipped response preserves stealth and forward momentum.

lines.speaker: SAYED

performance.delivery: Wrap the rifle while demonstrating the movement to Mostafa. Keep the warning tight and practical; the final order should carry quiet sergeant’s authority.

lines.text: الرَّمْلَةْ دِي تِعَطَّلْ أَجْدَعْ سِلَاحْ. لِفُّهْ كِدَهْ… وِمَا تْفُكُّوشْ غِيرْ لَمَّا أَقُولَّكْ.

performance.delivery: Answer Sayed immediately while copying the wrap. The full chest voice stays controlled, showing that Mostafa is frightened but trained.
